title: Stefano Ayaipoma – CV
text:
Data Science student, BYU–Idaho

fabiomayaipoma@gmail.com | LinkedIn | GitHub



Studying Data Science at Brigham Young University–Idaho. I’m interested in analytics, business, and using data to answer real-world questions.





Data Science major (in progress)
Coursework in R, Python, statistics, and data visualization.





Programming: R, Python

Data tools: tidyverse, dplyr, ggplot2, pandas

Other tools: RStudio, GitHub, Excel, Power BI

Strengths: data cleaning, basic statistical analysis, building simple dashboards and reports





Scripture Text Analysis – Used R to clean and analyze scripture text and create visualizations.

Interactive Time Series Dashboard – Built a Quarto report with interactive time plots for a class project.




Data science, business analytics, visualization, and learning new tools that help make data easier to understand.
